newsitem.title: USA: Reading & Bates initiates stock sale plan.
newsitem.headline: Reading & Bates initiates stock sale plan.

text.p: Reading & Bates Corp said Monday it has retained Shareholder Communications Corp to manage a voluntary commission-free selling program for shareholders who, as of September 27, owned fewer than 100 shares of Reading & Bates common stock.
The program will give eligible shareholders the opportunity to sell all of their eligible shares, a statement from Reading & Bates said.
The price to be paid will be a weighted average sales price, the company said.
This uniform price will be based on those Reading & Bates shares submitted from Oct. 7 to Nov. 7 and then sold in the open market, the company said.
